title: 공부하다 허브(홈·달력)로 나오면 자동 측정이 '대기'로 끝나고, 그 뒤로 쉰 시간은 기록되지 않음
screen: 허브 홈·공부 달력·시계 알약(세 뷰포트 모두)
repro: 1) 강의(#/CONS/WHT/learn)에서 10분 공부(자동 측정 '공부 중'). 2) 메뉴 '오늘'(또는 시계 팝오버 '공부 달력 · 오늘 기록 고치기', 빵부스러기 JBL)을 누름. 3) 허브 홈에 둔 채 22분 동안 입력하지 않음(또는 잠금). 4) 다시 움직임
expected: 사용자 요청("내가 공부하다가 멈추면 쉬는시간 측정되게끔") 그대로, 공부를 멈추고 허브에 머무는 동안 ☕ 휴식이 흘러가야 함. 알약에 '휴식 m:ss', 홈 띠에 '☕ 쉬는 중'이 뜨고, 돌아오면 [☕ 쉬었어요][📖 공부했어요] 띠가 떠야 함
actual: 허브로 나오는 즉시 알약이 '0:10:30 대기'가 됨. 12분·22분이 지나도, 다시 움직여도 계속 '대기'이고 휴식 기록(trest)·되묻는 띠(#idleband)·알림이 모두 없음. 달력으로 가도 똑같음
evidence: p4.py(가짜 시계): a_doc {st:'run', ck:'0:10:29 공부 중'} → b_home {st:'wait', ck:'0:10:30 대기'} → d_home_idle22 {st:'wait'} → e_back(입력) {st:'wait', ib:null} · 맥·아이패드 세로·가로 모두 같음
cause: docs/index.html 2462 home(): `if(T.run&&T.autoRun)tStop();` · 2194 calView(): 같은 줄. 여기서 쓰는 것은 tStop뿐이고 trAutoRest는 부르지 않음. 그런데 자동 휴식(trAutoRest)은 T.run일 때 무활동·숨김·blur 세 경로에서만 시작됨. 허브에서는 T.run이 이미 false라서 휴식이 시작될 길이 없음
fix: 허브로 나갈 때 tStop 뒤에 T.hubLeft = 떠난 시각을 남긴다. 1초 타이머(무활동 판정)에서 VIEW!=='doc' && T.hubLeft && restOn()이고 그날 공부가 0보다 크면, now−T.hubLeft ≥ 1분(또는 idleMin)일 때 tstate {st:'rest',from:'auto',ar:1,why:'hub',r0:T.hubLeft}를 쓴다(trAutoRest와 같은 모양). 허브에서 visibilitychange hidden이 오면 곧바로 같은 휴식으로 넘어간다. 과목 문서를 다시 열면 T.hubLeft를 지우고, 2분 안이면 지금처럼 이어서 잰다. 회귀: ux3_rest에 '학습 → 메뉴 오늘 → 20분 무입력 → 알약 휴식·돌아오면 띠' 추가
verify:
I reproduced this with a playwright fake clock, script at /Users/jumisong/JBL/work/_tmp/ux4c_1_0/r.py.
- Mac 1280, going to the hub with the menu '오늘': after 10 minutes of study in the lecture, the clock pill showed 'run 0:10:00 공부 중'. On the hub it switched straight to 'wait 0:10:00 대기'. It stayed 'wait' after 22 minutes with no input and after the next input as well. tstate and trest in localStorage stayed null, and #idleband never appeared.
- iPad portrait 820, going to #/_cal: same result.
- No console errors in either run.

Cause, confirmed in the code (docs/index.html):
- home() at line 2462 and calView() at line 2194 only call `if(T.run&&T.autoRun)tStop();` and never call trAutoRest.
- trAutoRest has only three callers, and each needs T.run:
  - the 1-second idle timer at line 1887, which returns early on `if(!T.run)return`
  - visibilitychange hidden at line 1888 (`if(T.run)`)
  - blur at line 2012 (`if(T.run)`)
- So on the hub no rest can ever start.
- The help text at line 1792 does not list 'leaving to the hub' as a way to start a rest either. That goes against the user's request "공부하다가 멈추면 쉬는시간 측정되게끔".

The high severity is justified: after a common action (going back to the hub, then resting), the break time is silently not recorded at all. I did not run the landscape iPad viewport, because the code path does not depend on viewport width.

title: 허브 홈 '이번 주' 합계·오늘 막대·과목 표 시간 칸이 세션 중·멈춘 뒤에도 옛 값에 머묾(같은 화면에서 숫자가 서로 다름)
screen: 허브 홈(이번 주·과목 표)
repro: 오늘 1:00이 기록된 상태에서 허브 홈 [▶ 공부 시작] → 30분 세션 → [■ 멈춤]. 화면은 그대로 둠
expected: 머리 '오늘 1:30', 메뉴 '이번 주 1:30', 이번 주 합계·오늘 막대, 과목 표 오늘/전체 시간이 모두 같은 값
actual: 머리·메뉴·알약은 1:30인데, 이번 주 합계 [data-hw=tot]와 오늘 막대는 멈춘 뒤에도 '1:00'으로 남음. 다른 화면에 다녀와야 바뀜
evidence: p7.py: b_sess30 {band:'오늘 1:30', wk:'이번 주 1:30', hw:'1:00', todayW:'1:00 오늘'} · e_stop(■ 뒤) {hw:'1:00', todayW:'1:00 오늘'}
cause: 2474~2475 homeTick(30초)이 [data-hb](오늘 합계·목표)와 [data-hbw] 막대만 고침. homeWeek의 [data-hw=tot]·.hwb 막대와 homeSubjects의 .hct/.hctt는 home()이 그릴 때 한 번만 계산됨. 상태가 바뀌어도(tBtn → trkAll) 홈을 다시 그리지 않음
fix: homeTick에서 tWeek(tMon(now))로 [data-hw=tot]·하루 평균·오늘 .hwb 막대 높이와 글자, 과목 행 .hct/.hctt 글자도 바꾼다. 또는 VIEW==='home'일 때 tBtn의 상태 전환(sess→end, rest→sess)에서 hweek·hsubj 절만 다시 그린다
verify:
I reproduced this at Mac width 1280 using work/_tmp/ux4c_1_1/r.py, which drives Playwright with a mocked clock. Steps: start on the hub home, press ▶ 공부 시작, move the mouse every 55 s for about 35 minutes, then press ■ 멈춤 and let 31 s pass so homeTick runs.

| Moment | Header [data-hb=td] | Weekly total [data-hw=tot] | Today bar (.hwv / .hwf height) |
|---|---|---|---|
| During the session | 0:32 | 0:00 | empty / 0% |
| After ■ 멈춤 | 0:32 | 0:00 | empty / 0% |
| After calling __h.home() again | 0:32 | 0:32 | 0:32 / 12.4% |

So on the same screen the header shows 0:32 while the weekly total and today's bar stay at the old value. They only update once home() redraws the page.

The cause matches the report (docs/index.html):
- **homeTick (line 2473):** it only updates [data-hb] and [data-hbw].
- **tBtn (line 1875):** it only runs ckPaint and trkAll, so it redraws the [data-trk] pieces and never refreshes the hweek or hsubj sections.
- **Subject table cells .hct/.hctt (line 2531):** these are drawn once, the same way. I could not see them in this run because time with no subject open is saved under 기타, which has no subject row. The code path is the same, though, so time recorded while a subject is open should leave them stale too.

It is a medium issue: numbers on one screen disagree, but no data is lost.

title: 키보드로 버튼에 포커스를 두고 Enter·Space를 눌러도 반응 없음(시계 알약·이어서 카드·메뉴 항목 등)
screen: 허브 홈·상단 막대·허브 메뉴(키보드 사용 시 — 맥, 아이패드 하드웨어 키보드)
repro: 허브 홈에서 Tab(또는 focus())으로 #clock에 포커스 → Enter 또는 Space를 누름. '계속하기' 카드(.hrbig)와 메뉴 '공부 달력'에서도 똑같이 해 봄
expected: 팝오버가 열리거나 그 화면으로 이동
actual: 아무 일도 없음. 역할이 link인 div인 과목 행(.hsj)만 자기 처리기가 있어서 Enter가 됨
evidence: p5.py: clock_enter false · clock_space false · resume_enter '#/' (그대로) · nav_enter '#/' (그대로) · subj_enter '#/CONS/_home/_home' (됨)
cause: 3342~3343 전역 keydown: `if((isEnter||isSpace)&&onBtn)e.preventDefault();` — 마우스 클릭 뒤 남은 포커스를 막으려고 넣은 줄이 키보드 포커스까지 모두 막음
fix: 포인터로 생긴 포커스일 때만 막는다: `if((isEnter||isSpace)&&onBtn&&!tg.matches(':focus-visible'))e.preventDefault();`. 또는 pointerup 뒤 버튼을 blur한다. 한 장씩 풀기 ✓ 뒤 Enter 회귀(ux2)가 계속 통과하는지 확인
verify:
Reproduced at 1280 using file:///Users/jumisong/JBL/docs/index.html. Scripts are in /Users/jumisong/JBL/work/_tmp/ux4c_1_2/ (r.py, r2.py).

Results:
- #clock focused with focus() or with real Tab presses (it matches :focus-visible), then Enter: no click event fires (a counter listener stays at 0) and the DOM does not change. Space gives the same result. A mouse click on #clock fires 1 click and the DOM grows by about 480 chars (tPop opens).
- The resume card .hrbig (a BUTTON), focused, then Enter: the hash stays '#/'.
- The menu '공부 달력' (a BUTTON), focused, then Enter: the hash stays '#/' and the view does not change.

Cause confirmed in docs/index.html:3342-3343. The global keydown handler computes `onBtn=tg.closest('button,a,summary')` and then runs `if((isEnter||isSpace)&&onBtn)e.preventDefault();` for every Enter or Space, whether the focus came from the mouse or the keyboard. This blocks native button activation on the hub home, the top bar, the hub menu, and likely every page. The only exceptions are elements with their own key handler, such as the .hsj div rows and the one-at-a-time Enter.

The user does use a hardware keyboard on iPad and Mac. However, their main input is pen or touch and they rely on letter shortcuts, and every control still works by click or tap. So this is a real accessibility and keyboard-use regression, but it is not data loss: medium.

The proposed fix (skip preventDefault when tg.matches(':focus-visible')) looks sound, because Tab-focused buttons match :focus-visible and mouse-focused buttons normally do not. The ux2 regression for "Enter after ✓ in one-at-a-time mode" must be re-run. That path is also handled earlier by its own JB.one branch, which calls preventDefault itself.

title: 쉬는 중에는 시계 알약 폭이 1초마다 바뀌어 검색칸이 좌우로 흔들리고, 상태가 바뀔 때마다 30px씩 밀림
screen: 상단 막대(모든 화면·세 뷰포트)
repro: 허브 홈 [▶ 공부 시작] → [☕ 쉬기] → 상단 막대를 12초 동안 봄
expected: 알약·검색칸 자리가 고정(숫자 폭 고정)
actual: 알약 폭이 135.5~142.4px 사이로 계속 바뀌고, 검색칸 왼쪽 끝이 843.6~850.5px로 초마다 움직임. 대기→세션→휴식 전환 때는 116.7 → 146 → 142px라 검색칸이 29px 밀림
evidence: p13.py(맥): widths [116.7,135.5,…,146] · searchLeft [840 … 869.3] · fontVariantNumeric 'tabular-nums'인데도 폭이 바뀜. 글꼴 Pretendard 없음 → Apple SD Gothic Neo 대체(고정폭 숫자 기능 없음). 아이패드 두 폭도 같은 값
cause: 1218·1223 #top #clock / #clock .ckl — font-variant-numeric만 있고 최소 폭이 없음. 대체 글꼴에 tnum이 없어 숫자 폭이 들쭉날쭉. 상태 글자(대기/세션 h:mm/휴식 m:ss/자리 비움 m:ss) 길이도 서로 다름
fix: `#clock .ckt,#clock .ckl{display:inline-block;text-align:left}` + `.ckt{min-width:4.6em}` + `.ckl{min-width:5.8em}`(가장 긴 '자리 비움 12:34' 기준). 또는 알약 폭을 고정하고 숫자를 font-feature-settings:'tnum'이 있는 글꼴로. 600px 이하는 .ckl을 숨기니 그대로 둠
verify:
I reproduced this with work/_tmp/ux4c_1_3/r.py (Playwright Chromium) on docs/index.html at 1280x800, 820x1180 (touch) and 1180x820 (touch). Steps: open the hub home, click #clock, choose [▶ 공부 시작], click #clock again, choose [☕ 쉬기], then read the size of #clock and the left edge of #gsearch once a second for 12 seconds.

1. **Resting, every second:** the pill width wanders between 139.1 and 146.0px and the search box's left edge follows it (840.0–846.9px at 1280). The ckt text stays at 0:00:01 the whole time. Only the ckl label changes ('휴식 0:00'…'0:11'), so the label's variable-width digits cause it, not the main time.
2. **State changes:** idle 120.3px ('0:00:00 대기') becomes 145.8px in a session ('세션 0:00') and 146px when resting. That moves the search box 25.6px to the left (865.8 to 840.2).
3. **All three viewports:** the pill widths are identical, and the search box shifts by the same amounts from a different starting point.

The computed font-family starts with Pretendard, and the reporter found that Pretendard is not installed, so Apple SD Gothic Neo is used, which has no fixed-width digits. #clock only sets font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums (lines 1218 and 551). .ckt/.ckl have no min-width, and the pill sits to the right of the flex spacer (.sp flex:1) and #gsearch, so any width change moves the search box.

Measured in Chromium, not on a real iPad Safari. It is cosmetic, with no data impact, but the search box moves 3–7px every second on every screen while resting, which goes against the user's request for a clean, stable layout. The suggested fix (inline-block plus a min-width on .ckt/.ckl) fits the cause.

title: 좁은 폭 서랍을 열어도 포커스가 서랍으로 가지 않고, Tab이 가림막 뒤 본문으로 빠져나감
screen: 아이패드 세로(820) 허브 메뉴 서랍
repro: 820×1180에서 ☰(#navbtn)를 누르고 하드웨어 키보드 Tab을 25번 누름
expected: 열자마자 포커스가 서랍 첫 항목에 가고, Tab은 서랍 안에서만 돌며, 닫으면 ☰로 돌아옴
actual: 포커스가 ☰에 그대로 남음. Tab 순서는 상단 막대(서랍에 가려 보이지 않음) 4개 → 서랍 12개 → 가림막 뒤 홈 본문으로 샘. #main이 inert가 아님
evidence: p3.py drawer_tab 'TTTTSSSSSSSSSSSSHHHHHHHHH' (T=상단 막대, S=서랍, H=홈 본문) · p14.py drawer: activeElement 'navbtn', #main.inert false
cause: 2568 navOpen(): body.navopen·html.navlock만 켬. 포커스 이동도, 뒤 화면 inert도 없음
fix: navOpen(true)이고 innerWidth≤860이면 #main·#top에 inert를 주고 $('#nav .ni[aria-current],#nav .ni').focus({preventScroll:true})로 포커스를 옮긴다. 닫을 때 inert를 풀고 #navbtn으로 포커스를 돌려준다
verify: I reproduced this exactly with work/_tmp/ux4c_1_4/drawer.py (playwright, 820×1180, file:///Users/jumisong/JBL/docs/index.html). After clicking #navbtn, body.navopen is true, but document.activeElement is still 'navbtn' and #main.inert is false. Pressing Tab 25 times gives 'TTTTSSSSSSSSSSSSHHHHHHHHH': the top bar hidden behind the drawer, then the drawer's 12 items, then focus leaks into the home content behind the overlay. One thing the report missed: after closing with Escape, focus goes to BODY instead of back to ☰, so the focus-return part is also missing. Cause: navOpen() at docs/index.html line 2568 only toggles body.navopen and html.navlock. It never moves focus or sets inert, and 'inert' appears nowhere else in the file. This only affects hardware-keyboard/accessibility navigation, so severity stays low. Suggested fix: when opening at width ≤860, set inert on #main and #top and focus the current or first .ni item. When closing, remove inert and focus #navbtn.

title: 같은 동작인데 화면마다 버튼 이름이 다름: '■ 멈춤' / '■ 종료' / '■ 공부 멈춤', '▶ 다시 공부' / '▶ 다시'
screen: 허브 홈 머리 띠·시계 팝오버·⏱ 크게·달력 측정 카드
repro: 세션 또는 휴식 중에 홈 띠, 시계 팝오버, ⏱ 크게, 달력 '측정' 카드의 버튼을 비교
expected: 같은 동작은 같은 이름(예: ■ 멈춤 · ▶ 다시 공부 · ☕ 쉬기)
actual: 홈 띠와 팝오버는 '■ 멈춤', ⏱ 크게와 달력 카드는 '■ 종료'. 다시 시작은 '▶ 다시 공부'와 '▶ 다시'가 섞임
evidence: p2.py big.t '… ▶ 다시 ■ 종료 닫기 Esc' · cal_txt '측정 ● 세션 0:00 ☕ 쉬기 ■ 종료 ⏱ 크게' · band '▶ 다시 공부 ■ 멈춤'
cause: 2140 trkInner: band가 아닌 곳(card·big·nav)은 B('stop','종료','■')·B('resume','다시','▶',1)
fix: trkInner의 card·big 버튼 이름을 band와 같게('멈춤', '다시 공부')
verify:
I confirmed this by reading the built docs/index.html. I did not run a browser: the labels are fixed text in the code, so which one shows depends only on the screen and the timer state. The same actions get different button names depending on where they are drawn.

In trkInner (line 2141), the home header band (w==='band') shows '■ 멈춤' and '▶ 다시 공부'. The calendar card (trkUI('card'), line 2215) and ⏱ big view (trkUI('big'), line 2355) instead show '■ 종료' and '▶ 다시' for the same stop/resume actions: `B('stop','종료','■')` and `B('resume','다시','▶',1)`.

The clock popover (tPopHTML, lines 4384-4386) adds more variants for the same stop action: '■ 공부 멈춤' while auto-measuring, '■ 세션 끝내기' during a session, '■ 멈춤' while resting. Its resume button reads '▶ 다시 공부'. The rest button is '☕ 쉬기 시작' in the popover and '☕ 쉬기' elsewhere.

SPEC line 1791 in the page's help table still describes '▶ 다시 → ■ 종료', which also disagrees with the home header band.

This is a real naming inconsistency against the user's request for a clean, readable screen. It is cosmetic and nothing breaks. Suggested fix: in trkInner, change the card and big labels to '멈춤' and '다시 공부' to match the band, and decide whether the popover keeps its context-specific stop labels (the session one is arguably informative) or uses a single name.

So just after rest starts, with rest total 0:00, it shows '집중 32%' (100% in the original report), which means nothing. title: 오늘 공부 시간 표기가 화면마다 다름(01:30:04 / 1:30:04, 반올림 0:11 / 0:10:30)

repro: 10분 30초 공부한 뒤 알약, 홈 머리 '오늘', 달력 '오늘 공부' 카드를 비교
expected: 같은 값·같은 형식(알약 기준 h:mm:ss, 분 단위는 내림)

cause: 알약은 ckFmt(fmt에서 앞 0 뺌), 달력 카드·bigTick은 fmt, 홈은 fmtH(분 반올림)
fix: 달력 카드와 ⏱ 크게도 ckFmt를 쓴다. 공부 합계를 보여 주는 fmtH는 Math.floor로(목표 %·막대도 같은 값)
verify: Reproduced by reading the code. docs/index.html and tools/cons/shell.html have the same code. I ran no browser test, but the mismatch follows directly from the code. (1) The calendar 'today study' card (#cc-td, both the first render and calTick) and the big-clock number (bigTick b.textContent=fmt(v)) use fmt, which pads hours to two digits: 10m30s shows as '00:10:30' and 1h30m04s as '01:30:04'. The clock pill uses ckFmt, which drops the leading zero, so the same values show there as '0:10:30' and '1:30:04'. (2) The home header's 'today' value, homeTick, and the text under the big clock use fmtH, which is Math.round(ms/60000). So 10m30s shows as '0:11', and 3:59:30 shows as '4:00', which makes the goal look met 30 seconds early. homeTick's pct (Math.round(td/goal*100)) also rounds up. The fix in the report is correct: use ckFmt for the calendar card and bigTick, and change fmtH to Math.floor (fmtH is also used for rest and session times, so check those spots too). Severity is low: this is a display-consistency issue and no data is lost.

evidence: search_ipadP.png, second result
cause: tools/cons/build4.py:543 tip = ' <small>빨간 글씨를 자동 빈칸으로 가리고 떠올리기</small>' — no noann class, so shell.html:3457 sText does not remove it.

verify:
I reproduced this on the built site (docs/index.html, 820x1180 viewport, Playwright script at work/_tmp/ux4c_1_51/r.py). I typed 'bleaching' into #gsearch. The second result, "CONS · Tooth whitening · 카드 1 Causes of Discoloration", shows this snippet: "…(슬라이드 7 필기). · ⚡ 암기 빨간 글씨를 자동 빈칸으로 가리고 떠올리기 · Extrinsic = 표면 침착 → 기계적 제거…". Cause confirmed. tools/cons/build4.py line 543 builds the hint as `tip = ' <small>빨간 글씨를 자동 빈칸으로 가리고 떠올리기</small>'` with no noann class. In tools/cons/shell.html line 3457, sText() strips only .acts, button, .noann and a few other classes, so this <small> stays in the search text. A related minor point: the '⚡ 암기' label itself (in .ct) is also indexed. This is the same pattern as the other block labels, such as 💬 교수님 강조.

title: The year-chip preview's ✓ 맞음 / ✗ 틀림 buttons turn into filled colors when on, and a grade cannot be undone there
screen: Lecture notes ⭐ year chip → JB preview (#jbpeek)
repro: In a lecture learn tab, press a ⭐ year chip → press ✓ 맞음.
expected: The same no-fill grading buttons as JB (B3-6) and the same toggle behavior (press again to undo).
actual: The button gets a mint (ok) or pink (ng) fill. It uses mark(...,'set'), so pressing again does not undo a mistaken grade.
evidence: shell.html:711 .jbpeek .jpb .on[data-jpmk=ok]{background:var(--mint)} · 3987 mark(q,d.jpmk,'set')
cause: The preview CSS and handler were not updated to the new JB button rules.
fix: Use the same on style as #cards .acts [data-mk] (bold text or underline, no fill), and switch to 'toggle' (keep MKFIX consistent).
verify:
I reproduced this in docs/index.html at #/CONS/CRK/learn, 1180x820, using playwright. The script is work/_tmp/ux4c_1_52/r.py and the screenshot is peek.png. There were no console errors.

Steps: press the first ⭐ year chip, which opens #jbpeek.on.
- Before grading, both buttons have a white background (rgb 255,255,255).
- Pressing ✓ 맞음 makes it `btn sm on` with a mint fill, rgb(240,245,240).
- Pressing ✓ 맞음 again leaves it `on` with the same fill. It cannot be undone because line 3987 of the shell uses `mark(q,d.jpmk,'set')`.
- Pressing ✗ 틀림 swaps the grade and gives a pink fill, rgb(251,227,224).

The JB list button (`#cards .qc .acts [data-mk=ok]`) has a white background with no fill. Its CSS comment (shell 1685, B3-6) describes the on state as ink bold text, red text for 틀림, and no fill. Line 711 of the shell (`.jbpeek .jpb .on[data-jpmk=ok]{background:var(--mint)}` and the ng rule `#FBE3E0`) was never moved to the new rules. The same CSS is in the built docs/index.html.

On the undo part: the comment at line 2790 says 'set' is intended for the one-at-a-time answer bar and O/X, so the no-undo behaviour matches one-at-a-time mode. However, it is inconsistent with the list-card buttons that the preview copies, which use 'toggle'. Because of that, both the fill mismatch and the missing undo count as real.

Severity is low: it is only a visual inconsistency and a mistaken grade that can't be cleared from the preview. No data is lost, and pressing the other button changes the grade.

title: The answer-toggle labels disagree: one-by-one mode shows '자세히 ▾' while the card shows '답 가리기 ▲', and in the list Space on an open card goes to 자세히 even though the label says 가리기
screen: JB questions (list and one-by-one), answer steps 1 and 2
repro: 1) One-by-one: Space once → the bottom button says '자세히 ▾' but the card's own button says '답 가리기 ▲'. 2) List: J → Space (open) → the card button says '답 가리기 ▲' → Space again expands to 자세히 instead of hiding.
expected: The next action is labeled the same way everywhere (step 1 open → '자세히 ▾' → '답 가리기 ▲').
actual: togLabel only looks at open, so it shows '답 가리기 ▲' even though qStep's next step is deep.
evidence: s1.py one1.t1='자세히 ▾' (otog) vs s9.py steps[0]='open cur2|답 가리기 ▲'
cause: shell.html:2803 togLabel only uses open or l0; 2991 the [data-tog] click is a 2-step toggle and 4179 qStep (Space / otog) is 3-step.
fix: Make togLabel mirror qStep: open && !deep && has [data-deep] → '자세히 ▾'. Or change the Space in the list to a 2-step toggle to match the card button.
verify:
I reproduced the list-mode half of the report; the one-by-one half is mostly moot. The test ran against the built docs/index.html, CONS JB list, at 1280 wide, using work/_tmp/ux4c_1_53/r.py.

List mode, on card Q01 (which has a [data-deep] section):
- Pressing J leaves the card closed, and its button reads '답·해설'.
- Space #1 opens the card. The button changes to '답 가리기 ▲'.
- Space #2 does not hide the answer. It opens the detailed view (deep=true), and the button still reads '답 가리기 ▲'.
- Space #3 finally closes the card.

So the label promises "hide", but the next Space expands the detail. The cause:
- togLabel (shell.html:2803) only checks whether the card is open.
- qStep (shell.html:4179), which handles Space and the one-by-one bottom button (otog), is a 3-step cycle: open → deep → close.
- A click on the card's own [data-tog] button (shell.html:2991) is a 2-step open/close toggle. That button keeps reading '답 가리기 ▲' while Space follows the 3-step cycle, so the same card has two different behaviours.

One-by-one mode: JB.bar (shell.html:2853) labels otog correctly ('답 보기' → '자세히 ▾' → '답 가리기 ▲'). The card's own [data-tog] button is hidden there by CSS (shell.html:847, body.jbone ... >[data-tog]{display:none}), so the user never sees the two labels side by side. That half is a mismatch only in the DOM.

Severity is low: it is a confusing label and an extra key press, with no data loss.

Suggested fix: make togLabel follow qStep, showing '자세히 ▾' when the card is open, not deep, and has [data-deep]. Alternatively, make Space in the list a 2-step toggle like the card button.

title: The '카드 ▾' card list popup runs past the bottom of the screen, so the last 1–3 cards cannot be tapped (worst on iPad landscape)
screen: Lecture > 학습 tab > tab bar [카드 n/N ▾] popup (#lpop) — iPad landscape 1180x820 (all lectures), Mac 1280x900 and iPad portrait 820x1180 (long lectures such as PHARM RX)
repro: 1) iPad landscape 1180x820, open #/CONS/WHT/learn (top of page, not scrolled). 2) Tap [카드 1/19 ▾] in the tab bar. 3) Scroll the popup list all the way down.
expected: The popup ends above the screen bottom (and above the tool bar), and scrolling reaches the last card, '19 결론'.
actual: The popup spans top 212 to bottom 962, which is 142px past the 820px viewport. Scrolled to the end, the last visible card is 16; cards 17–19 are off-screen and cannot be tapped. At 1180, 3 cards are hidden in WHT, RX and DD1 and 1 in HIS. At Mac 1280x900 and 820 portrait, PHARM RX hides 1 card.
evidence: work/_tmp/ux4h_touchdata_1/p25.py output: l1180 WHT [212,962,820,20 cards,3 hidden] · RX [209,959,820,22,3] · DD1 [212,962,820,21,3] · HIS [212,836,820,13,1] · mac RX [204,955,900,22,1] · p820 RX [200,1226,1180,22,1]. p14.py: the last item '19결론' sits at 907–951 and elementFromPoint returns null. Screenshot work/_tmp/ux4h_touchdata_1/lpop1180.png (after scrolling to the end, only up to 16 is visible).
cause: CSS line 279: .pop{top:48px;max-height:calc(100vh - 70px)} assumes the popup starts at top 48px. The card list opener (docs/index.html line 2771, tools/cons/shell.html line 2771) moves it below the tab bar with p.style.top=(m.bottom+6)+'px' (about 200px at the top of the page) but does not recompute max-height, so the bottom goes past innerHeight by 'top − 48 − 22'px.
fix: When positioning it, also set p.style.maxHeight=(innerHeight-(m.bottom+6)-12-(kit visible? kit height:0))+'px' (preferably using visualViewport.height). Or give #lpop a CSS variable, e.g. max-height:calc(100dvh - var(--lpop-top) - 12px). Apply the same rule to other popups whose top is changed in JS (lvpop and others). Add a regression check: at three widths, the last .lpi's bottom ≤ innerHeight.
verify:
I reproduced this with Playwright (script work/_tmp/ux4c_1_54/r.py), opening the popup by clicking #lmcur at the top of the page and scrolling the list to its end.

| Viewport | Lecture | Popup top–bottom | Screen height | max-height | Cards | Off-screen |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1180x820 | CONS WHT | 207–876 | 820 | 750px | 20 | 2 (last one's bottom at 865) |
| 1280x900 | PHARM RX | 204–955 | 900 | 830px | 22 | 1 |
| 820x1180 | PHARM RX | 195–946 | 1180 | 1110px | 22 | 0 |

The report's exact numbers differ slightly: it says 962 and 3 hidden at 1180; I got 876 and 2 (the item count of 20 includes the "↑ 이 강의의 틀" row). Portrait 820 did not reproduce in this build; the list is shorter than the screen there.

The cause is as reported. The .pop class in CSS (line 279) sets top:48px and max-height:calc(100vh - 70px). lpopOpen (docs/index.html line 2773) moves the popup down with p.style.top=(m.bottom+6)+'px', which is about 200px, but does not recompute max-height. So the bottom of the popup overflows the screen by about 130 to 150px.

Severity is medium, not high. The last 1–3 cards on iPad landscape and Mac can't be tapped from the popup. However, J/K and scrolling the page still reach them, and no data is lost.

The suggested fix fits: set maxHeight from innerHeight (or visualViewport.height) minus the new top, a margin, and the tool bar's height when it is showing. Also check #lvpop for the same problem.

title: Highlighting across a line (finger or Apple Pencil direct drawing) silently deletes existing blanks, or the whole of a longer highlight, in the overlap
screen: Lecture 학습·정리표 — highlight mode (H) or Pencil direct drawing (penDirect, on by default on iPad)
repro: 1) iPad 820x1180, #/CONS/WHT/learn. 2) Blank mode (빈칸): tap one word in card 4 to make it a blank. 3) Highlight mode (형광펜): long-press, then drag from the start of that line to just past the blank (with Pencil direct drawing, dragging the Pencil with no mode on does the same). 4) Turn the mode off and look at the card.
expected: The blank the user made stays (a highlight can sit on top of it or wrap around it). If it is replaced, a toast says '빈칸 1개를 덮어썼어요 · ↶'.
actual: The blank disappears with no notice (h:0 b:1 → h:1 b:0). Likewise, painting one word inside a long existing highlight in another color removes the whole original highlight group (even the parts outside the overlap). You can undo right away, but on iPad, where Pencil highlights just by dragging, it is easy to lose blanks without noticing.
evidence: work/_tmp/ux4h_touchdata_1/p10.py: ['blank made',{h:0,b:1}] → ['after',{h:1,b:0}], and the list-item HTML has only data-rk=h left (no blank).
cause: docs/index.html line 3141 Kit.clearOverlap(B,a,b): unwraps every group (data-g) that touches the new range, whatever its type. apply() always calls it first (apply → clearOverlap → wrap).
fix: Limit clearOverlap to groups of the same type t (a highlight only overlaps other highlights), and wrap the highlight inside or outside existing blanks. Or, if other-type or partial-overlap groups are removed, show 'n개 표시를 덮어썼어요' with a [↶ 되돌리기] toast. For a partial overlap, keep the remaining pieces (split the group) instead of deleting it all.
verify: I reproduced this with work/_tmp/ux4h_touchdata_1/p10.py at iPad 820x1180 on #/CONS/WHT/learn, card #t-WHT-3. Making a blank gives {h:0,b:1}. A long-press highlight drag across it then gives {h:1,b:0}: the blank is gone, and the item's HTML now has only data-rk=h spans (group n2). The overlap toast never showed; the only notice is the ordinary '형광펜 1개' undo entry. Cause, confirmed in the code: docs/index.html line 3141 clearOverlap(B,a,b) collects the data-g of every [data-rk] element whose text overlaps [a,b). It does not check type and unwraps every node in each whole group. apply() (line 3145) always calls clearOverlap before wrap. The same code path explains the second claim, that a small other-color highlight inside a long highlight deletes the whole original group, including the parts outside the overlap. I read that in the code and did not run it separately. Undo does restore the blank, so this is medium, not data loss: it silently wipes user marks, which is easy to miss with penDirect drag on iPad. No files were changed.

title: The ⚡ 자동 (autopop) popup alone does not close when you tap outside it
screen: Lecture tool bar [⚡ 자동] popup — 820, 1180 (touch), 1280
repro: 1) #/CONS/WHT/learn, tap [⚡ 자동] in the tool bar. 2) Tap the body text in the middle of the screen (outside the popup).
expected: Like the other popups (🧹 지우기 clearpop, 보기 lvpop, clock tpop, 카드 lpop), it closes.
actual: The autopop stays open at all three widths. On iPad it covers the middle of the body text (820: 205–615 × 628–1106), so you have to find its close button.
evidence: p13.py: ['p820','#k-auto','STILL OPEN after outside tap',['autopop']] and the same for l1180 and mac. clearpop, tpop and lvpop close.
cause: autopop (docs/index.html #autopop, line 149 CSS) is probably missing from the outside-click close handler, i.e. the list of popups that close on a document click.
fix: Add #autopop to the same outside-tap close rule as the other popups. If it must stay open while settings change, only change is excluded, and taps outside the popup close it.
verify:
The bug is real. I reproduced it with work/_tmp/ux4c_1_56/t.py on #/CONS/WHT/learn at 820x1180 (touch), 1180x820 (touch) and 1280x800. At all three sizes #autopop was open after [⚡ 자동], and it was still open after a mouse click or touchscreen tap on stage body text outside the popup (DIV.outline, DIV.frt). Popup box: 820 = 205-615 x 628-1106, 1180 = 498-938 x 295-746, 1280 = 548-988 x 286-729. It covers the middle of the body text. Tapping the same point with #clearpop open does close clearpop at all three widths.

Cause, confirmed in docs/index.html: clearpop has its own capture-phase document click handler at line 3247 (`document.addEventListener('click',e=>{if($('#clearpop').classList.contains('on')&&!e.target.closest('#clearpop,#k-clear'))clearClose();},true);`). #autopop has no handler like that. It closes only from its own toggle button (3309), [적용] and [이 탭의 자동 빈칸 지우기] (3310/3313), clearMenu (3224), kitSet off (4543), overlaysClose (4576), and the pops list at line 3421, which looks like the Esc/back path.

Fix, source in tools/cons/shell.html: add the same capture-phase outside-click close for #autopop, excluding clicks inside '#autopop,#k-auto'. Changing settings inside the popup must not close it. Severity stays low: it is a convenience and consistency problem, and there is no data loss (the toggle button or Esc closes it).

title: Long-pressing a blank (to change its color) can also start native text selection on a real iPad
screen: Lecture 학습 — long-pressing a blank (.rk-b) with a finger to open the blank color popup (bcPop)
repro: 1) On a real iPad (Safari), with no mode on, long-press a blank you made with a finger for 0.5 s or more.
expected: Only the blank color popup appears.
actual: (Needs checking on a device.) CSS only sets -webkit-touch-callout:none on .rk-b and has no -webkit-user-select:none, so iOS may start text selection (handles and magnifier) at the same time as the popup. In Chromium emulation only the popup appears (bcpop:true).
evidence: docs/index.html line 1038 '.rk-b{-webkit-touch-callout:none}' — unlike #k-swl .sw and body.mode-h/mode-b #stage, user-select is not set. p4.py longpress blank → ['bcpop:true'].
cause: Missing user-select:none on .rk-b in the pointer:coarse environment.
fix: Add @media (pointer:coarse){#stage .rk-b{-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none}}, or on pointerdown briefly give body a class that blocks selection until the popup opens.
verify:
I confirmed this by reading the code. I could not test on a real iPad, and Chromium emulation cannot show iOS's native selection behaviour.

What the code does in docs/index.html:
- Line 1038 has only `.rk-b{-webkit-touch-callout:none}`. Nothing sets `-webkit-user-select:none` on `.rk-b`.
- Selection is blocked in only two cases: `body.mode-h #stage` and `body.mode-b #stage` under `@media (pointer:coarse)` (line 273), and `body.pen-drag #stage` (line 1194). The long-press colour popup is only for when no mode is on, so neither rule applies during it.
- The long-press handler at line 3297 listens for `pointerdown` in the capture phase, then calls `setTimeout(...,500)` and then `bcPop`. It never calls `preventDefault`, never calls `getSelection().removeAllRanges()`, and never blocks `selectstart`.
- On iOS Safari, `touch-callout:none` only hides the callout menu. A long press on selectable text still starts text selection (handles and magnifier) at about the same 0.5 s mark.

There is a possible worse case I could not check: `pointerup`, `pointercancel` and `scroll` clear the `BLP` timer. If iOS takes over the gesture for text selection and sends `pointercancel`, the timer is cleared and the popup may not open at all. Either way the colour-change long-press does not behave cleanly on iPad.

Severity is low: nothing is lost, and the user can dismiss the selection. The suggested fix is reasonable: add `@media (pointer:coarse){#stage .rk-b{-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none}}`. Optionally, also clear the selection when `bcPop` opens.

title: Return pill text uses the wrong Korean particle: 'Tooth whitening로 돌아가기'
screen: Lecture → tap a ⭐/연도 chip → JB tab, return pill (#retpill)
repro: #/CONS/WHT/learn → tap a card's jbchip '23' → look at the pill at the bottom right.
expected: 'Tooth whitening으로 돌아가기' (the English title ends in a consonant sound), or a form that sidesteps the particle: '↩ 돌아가기: Tooth whitening'.
actual: '↩ Tooth whitening로 돌아가기'
evidence: p20.py: ret ['↩ Tooth whitening로 돌아가기',583,1054,221,44]
cause: The return pill text adds '로' directly after the title, with no particle handling.
fix: Choose 으로/로 from the final sound of the last character (for a Latin title, treat a word ending in a consonant letter as needing 으로), or change the label to '↩ 돌아가기 · <제목>'.
verify: Confirmed from the source code. I did not run it in a browser. In tools/cons/shell.html:2622, retPill() sets `b.textContent='↩ '+RET.label+'로 돌아가기'`. The built docs/index.html has the same `RET.label+'로 돌아가기'`. Nothing picks between 로 and 으로. retFrom() (line 2619-2621) builds the label as sname(p,d), the English lecture title such as 'Tooth whitening', and adds ' 카드 N' when there is a probe position. On the JB tab it builds sname+' 기출 N/M' or '… 기출 <id>'. So the wrong particle is not limited to 'Tooth whitening로'. It shows on most labels: English words ending in a consonant, and numbers like '카드 3로' (should be 삼으로), '카드 1로' (일으로), '기출 6/10로' and so on. It is cosmetic only and nothing breaks, so low severity. Simplest fix: put the label after the verb, e.g. '↩ 돌아가기 · '+label. That avoids the particle for English, Korean and numbers alike.

title: 허브에서 쉬는 중 마우스·손가락을 한 번만 움직여도 휴식이 끝나고, 그 뒤로 허브에 계속 있어도 쉬는 시간이 다시 재지지 않음

repro: 1) 강의(#/CONS/WHT/learn)에서 5분 공부(자동 측정) 2) 허브 홈으로 나옴 → 1분 뒤 '☕ 쉬는 중'이 흐름 3) 5분 뒤 마우스를 한 번 움직임(또는 아이패드에서 화면을 한 번 톡) 4) 허브에서 10분 더 아무것도 안 함

evidence: work/_tmp/ux4h_hub_2/p2.py 출력: home+5m st=rest trest 300811 → mousemove st=wait, idleband '10:05부터 5분 공부를 멈췄어요…' → '+10m idle on hub' st=wait trest 310201(그대로)
cause: tAct(docs/index.html 1888행 부근)가 VIEW와 상관없이 모든 입력에서 `if(!document.hidden&&trAR())restBack(now,'inp')`로 자동 휴식을 끝냄. hubRest(2386행)는 시작할 때 T.hubLeft=0으로 비우므로 restBack 뒤에는 허브 휴식이 다시 무장되지 않음(setInterval 1890행의 hubRest('idle') 조건 T.hubLeft 실패).
fix: 허브 화면(VIEW 'home'·'cal'·'search')에서는 why==='hub'인 자동 휴식을 입력으로 끝내지 않고, 문서를 열 때(openDoc)·▶ 다시 공부·■ 멈춤에서만 restBack. 또는 허브에서 restBack한 경우 T.hubLeft=now·T.hubS/hubD를 유지해 다시 1분 입력이 없으면 hubRest가 이어서 재도록. 허브에서 끝낸 경우 '📖 공부했어요' 질문 띠는 띄우지 않음.
verify:
I reproduced it on the Mac viewport (1280) and the iPad portrait viewport (820). I used work/_tmp/ux4h_hub_2/p2.py for the Mac run and my variant work/_tmp/ux4c_2_0/p2_ipv.py, which taps instead of moving the mouse, for the iPad run.

What happened:
1. I studied CONS/WHT for 5 minutes, then went to the hub home. The clock showed "대기" at first, then "rest" after about 1 minute. After 5 minutes of rest, trest was about 300.8s.
2. A single mousemove (or a single tap on the iPad) immediately ended the rest: the state went to "wait". The band "10:05부터 5분 공부를 멈췄어요 [☕ 쉬었어요][📖 공부했어요]" appeared, even though the user never left the hub.
3. I then left the hub idle for 10 more minutes. The state stayed "wait" and trest stayed at 310211 / 310230, so those 10 minutes of rest were not recorded.

Why, from the code in docs/index.html:
- tAct (line 1888) calls restBack(now,'inp') on any input, whatever VIEW is.
- hubRest (line 2386) sets T.hubLeft=0 when it starts. After restBack, nothing sets T.hubLeft again.
- The setInterval at line 1890 only calls hubRest('idle') when T.hubLeft is set, so rest never starts again on the hub.

This goes against the user's instruction that rest time should be measured when they stop studying and take a break. Rest time is lost, and the prompt band appears at the wrong moment. I did not change any files.

fix: 취소를 .btn sm으로, @media (pointer:coarse)에서 .calset input[type=checkbox]를 24px+라벨 전체 누름 영역 44px로.
verify:
Only half of the report is real. I measured it with playwright at 820x1180 and 1180x820 with touch on (script: /Users/jumisong/JBL/work/_tmp/ux4c_2_12/r.py). The Mac 1280 run was only a comparison.

- **'취소' — real.** Open a record line's ✎ in the calendar day and the '취소' next to it is `<button class="link" data-cex>`. The `.link` style has padding 0, so it measures about 23x22px at both iPad widths. The '저장' button right beside it is `.btn sm` and gets the larger touch size. No `pointer:coarse` rule applies to `.link` or `[data-cex]`. It is small and sits right next to 저장, so a finger can easily miss it.
- **Measurement-settings checkboxes — not really a problem.** The input itself is 22x22, but the line 931 rule in docs/index.html already makes the surrounding `label.tauto` 44px tall under `pointer:coarse`. On iPad each label measured 750x44 (portrait) and 854x44 (landscape). Since the label wraps the checkbox, tapping anywhere on that line toggles it, so the touch target is already 44px. The report counted the bare input size.

Suggested fix: add only the '취소' change — make it `.btn sm` in `calEditHTML`, or give `[data-cex]` a 44px minimum under `pointer:coarse`. The checkbox rule can stay as it is.

title: 공부 순서 '이어서'가 JB 문제·한눈표·비교표·예상문제를 한 번 열고 오면 읽던 강의를 잃고 첫 강의 맨 위로 보냄

evidence: work/_tmp/ux4h_subject_2/p9.py 출력: home1 '이어서: Cracked tooth →' → after_jb/after_sum/after_tbl/after_pred 모두 '시작: Tooth whitening →' → 누른 뒤 ['#/CONS/WHT/learn','틀 · 19장/19▾',0]. after_pred의 최근 목록에는 예상문제·비교표·한눈표만 남음.

fix: savePos에서 CUR.d가 강의 키이면 LS 'lastLec.<S>'에 따로 저장하고, resumeTarget은 lastBy가 강의가 아닐 때 lastLec(없으면 lastList에서 강의 항목)을 먼저 본다. '최근 읽던 곳'도 마지막 강의 한 줄은 항상 남긴다.
verify:
I reproduced this exactly at 1280 on file:///Users/jumisong/JBL/docs/index.html. The script is /Users/jumisong/JBL/work/_tmp/ux4c_2_13/p9.py (copied from ux4h_subject_2/p9.py and run as is).

What happened:
- I cleared storage, opened #/CONS/CRK/learn and scrolled to card 6 (the page showed '카드 6/18'). Going to 과목 홈 then showed '이어서: Cracked tooth →', and '최근 읽던 곳' listed "Cracked tooth · 학습 · 6. Fractured Cusp", which is correct.

- After the fourth doc (예상문제), '최근 읽던 곳' showed only 예상문제, 비교표 and 한눈표, so Cracked tooth was gone from that list.

- resumeTarget at line 2690 accepts lastBy only when its d is a lecture key. Otherwise it picks the first lecture where lecProg shows unfinished cards, which here is the first lecture, WHT.
- lastList.<S> keeps only 3 entries (.slice(0,3), line 3866).

Every subject shares this logic, so the bug is not limited to CONS. I kept severity at high because the main '이어서' link on the subject home loses the user's lecture position after a single visit to a non-lecture tab.

title: '2회 이상만 풀기' 뒤로는 '안 푼 것 30 →'·'안 푼 것 풀기'·'틀린 것 다시'가 2회 이상 문항만 보여 줌(새로고침해도 그대로)
screen: 과목 홈 > 공부 순서 2단계 '안 푼 것 n →' · 진행률 [안 푼 것 풀기]·[틀린 것 다시] → JB 문제

expected: 버튼 글자대로 안 푼 기출 30문항이 모두 보이고, 정렬·출제 횟수 필터는 기본값이다.
actual: '안 푼 것' 칩만 켜지고 출제 횟수 ≥2 필터와 '출제 횟수 순' 정렬(fsort=n)은 남아서 30이 아니라 17문항만 보인다. 상태가 LS jbst.CONS._jb에 {n:2,sort:'n'}으로 저장되어 새로고침 뒤에도 그대로다. 과목 메뉴의 'JB 문제'로 들어갈 때만 jbPlain()이 풀어 준다.

cause: 과목 홈 클릭 처리의 d.jbf 분기(docs/index.html 약 3002행: openDoc(CUR.s,'_jb');jbHsMark();…[data-qf].click())는 mine만 바꾸고 F.n·F.sort·tiers·prof·yr·q는 그대로 둔다. d.jbn 분기는 F.n=2·sort='n'을 저장하고, 앞선 오류 수정(jbPlain)은 메뉴·머리 링크에만 걸려 있다.

Cause, confirmed in the code: in docs/index.html line 3001, the d.jbf branch only does openDoc, jbHsMark and a [data-qf] click. It never resets F.n, F.sort or the other filters. The d.jbn branch at line 3002 saves n=2 and sort='n'.

title: 강의에서 켠 형광펜·빈칸 모드가 과목 홈·다른 과목까지 따라가 도구 막대 없이 켜져 있고, 다른 과목 강의에서 첫 드래그가 바로 칠해짐
screen: 과목 사이 이동(과목 바꾸기·허브 메뉴·뒤로가기) → 과목 홈 → 다른 과목 강의
repro: 1) #/CONS/WHT/learn에서 H(한글 상태 ㅗ)로 형광펜을 켬. 2) 과목 메뉴 [과목 바꾸기 ▾] → 구강외과1을 고름. 3) 구강외과1 과목 홈에서 도구 막대를 찾아봄. 4) 강의 DD I을 열고 글을 드래그해 선택함.
expected: 강의 밖(과목 홈)으로 나오거나 과목이 바뀌면 모드가 꺼지거나, 적어도 켜진 상태가 보인다. 다른 과목에서 드래그하면 그냥 글이 선택된다.
actual: 과목 홈에서 body.mode-h가 남아 있고 #kit은 display:none이라 켜진 줄 모른다. 구강외과1 강의에서 첫 드래그가 바로 형광펜으로 저장된다(ann.OMS1 0→1). 세 뷰포트 모두 같다.

cause: openDoc()·home()·leaveView()가 Kit 모드를 끄지 않는다. 과목 홈은 CSS body.d-home #kit{display:none}으로 막대만 숨긴다. 이전에 보고된 't로 막대를 숨겨도 모드가 남음'과 증상은 같지만 원인 경로(화면 이동)가 다르다.
fix: leaveView()에서 CUR.s가 바뀌거나, 가는 곳이 강의 학습·정리표가 아니면(과목 홈·JB·허브) Kit 모드를 끈다(Kit.setMode(null) 같은 함수). 과목 안에서 모드를 유지하는 게 의도라면 과목이 바뀔 때와 d-home일 때만이라도 끄고 알림을 띄운다.
verify:
I reproduced this at 1280 wide on the current docs/index.html, with no console errors (script: work/_tmp/ux4c_2_15/r1.py, r2.py).

Steps: I pressed H (sent as 'ㅗ') in #/CONS/WHT/learn, which set body to mode-h. I then used [과목 바꾸기] to go to OMS1, which opens the OMS1 subject home.

What I saw:
1. On the OMS1 subject home, body still had mode-h and the #kit bar was hidden (computed display:none). Nothing on screen shows that highlight mode is on.
2. I then opened OMS1/DD1/learn. body still had mode-h and #kit was flex, so the highlight button shows as pressed.
3. The first drag in that lecture was saved straight away as a highlight: ann.OMS1 went from 0 to 1.
4. Going back to CONS, mode-h was still on.

Cause: Kit.setMode is not called from openDoc, home or leaveView (docs/index.html lines 2472, 2601, 2650). Only the subject home hides the bar, through CSS `body.d-home #kit{display:none}` (line 506).

Correction to the report: in the other subject's lecture the bar is visible and the button looks pressed, so the mode being on is not completely hidden there. The hidden state applies only on the subject home.

Still medium: the mode crosses subjects with no notice, the first drag writes an unintended mark into the other subject's data, and the subject home gives no sign the mode is on.

I only tested 1280 wide. I did not repeat the three-viewport check the report describes.

title: 집중 모드가 과목 홈까지 이어져 과목 머리(제목·기출/비교표/예상 링크)·메뉴·상단 막대가 사라짐(허브 홈에서는 무시되어 서로 다름)

actual: 과목 홈에서 #top이 display:none, 메뉴 버튼·서랍 없음, hero 높이 0(과목 이름·'기출 30 · 2회 이상 17 · 강의 7 · 비교표 · 예상' 줄 없음)이고 '과목 홈 [집중 끝]' 막대만 남는다. 허브 홈에서는 같은 focus 클래스인데 상단 막대·메뉴가 보인다(at-home은 예외).

I reproduced this at all three widths (820×1180 touch, 1180×820 touch, 1280×800 mouse) with work/_tmp/ux4c_2_16/r.py, an adapted copy of p10.py. The steps were: open CONS subject home, open the first lecture, turn on [⤢ 집중] in the learn tab, go back, go to hub home, reload, go back again.

Measured state on the subject home (#/CONS/_home/_home) at every width:
- focus class is on, #top is display:none and the menu button is hidden.
- #side is hidden at 1180/1280, and #hero has height 0.
- The only visible bar is the '과목 홈 [집중 끝]' strip.

On hub home (#/) the same focus class is still on, but #top shows (display:flex), and the menu button (at 820) or side menu (right edge 256px at 1180/1280) is visible. So the two homes behave differently.

title: [과목 바꾸기 ▾] 목록이 role=menu인데 ↑↓ 키가 과목 사이를 움직이지 않고 메뉴 칸만 스크롤함
screen: 과목 메뉴 > 과목 바꾸기 팝오버(.nvswp) — 맥·아이패드 하드웨어 키보드
repro: 1) 과목 메뉴에서 Tab으로 [과목 바꾸기 ▾]에 포커스를 두고 Enter를 누름(팝오버 열림). 2) ↓를 누름.
expected: 첫 과목(또는 다음 과목)으로 포커스가 가고, ↑↓·Enter로 고를 수 있다(role=menu/menuitem 관례).
actual: 포커스는 버튼에 그대로 있고 메뉴 칸(#navsc)만 40px 스크롤되어 팝오버가 위로 밀린다(pop top 151→111). Tab으로만 들어갈 수 있다.
evidence: work/_tmp/ux4h_subject_2/p3.py: pop_lec pop [36,151,…] → pop_arrow pop [36,111,…], ae 'nvsw on'(세 뷰포트 모두 40px 이동).
cause: navSwTog()(docs/index.html 4375행 부근)는 열고 닫기만 하고 키 처리가 없다. role='menu'·role='menuitem'만 붙어 있다.
fix: 열 때 지금 과목 항목에 포커스를 주고, 팝오버 keydown에서 ArrowUp/Down/Home/End로 항목(aria-disabled 건너뜀) 사이를 옮기고 preventDefault한다. 아니면 role=menu를 빼고 보통 버튼 목록으로 둔다.
verify: I reproduced it on the CONS subject home at 1280 and 1180 widths (script: /Users/jumisong/JBL/work/_tmp/ux4c_2_17/r.py). I put focus on [과목 바꾸기 ▾] and pressed Enter. The popover opened but focus stayed on the button ('nvsw on'). After that, ↓↓↑ and End did not move focus to any item. I then pressed Tab, which moved focus to the first item (OMS1). ↓ from there still did not move focus (it stayed on OMS1). So the list has role=menu and role=menuitem, but the keys that role implies do nothing, both from the button and from inside the list. The code agrees. navSwTog() (docs/index.html line 4375) only opens and closes the popover. The popover's only key handler, at line 4377, handles Escape alone. No code handles ArrowUp or ArrowDown for the popover. One part of the report did not reproduce here: on the subject home, #navsc did not scroll (scrollTop stayed 0, pop top stayed 151). That is because the menu is short on that page. The report measured the 40px scroll on a lecture page with a long card table of contents (p3.py), where the menu can scroll. Either way the cause is the same: arrow keys have no handler, so the browser's default action applies. This is an accessibility and keyboard-convenience problem only. You can still pick a subject with Tab and Enter, or by clicking, and no data is affected. Severity: low. The report's suggested fix fits: focus the current subject when the menu opens and let arrow keys move between items, or remove role=menu.

title: 과목 메뉴 '내 표시' 개수가 형광펜·빈칸을 칠해도 나타나지 않거나 늦게 바뀜
screen: 과목 메뉴 > 이 과목 문서 '내 표시' 줄
repro: 1) 표시가 하나도 없는 상태에서 #/CONS/WHT/learn을 열고 H로 형광펜을 켜 한 줄을 칠함. 2) 과목 메뉴 '내 표시' 오른쪽 숫자를 봄.
expected: 바로 '내 표시 1'이 된다(허브 메뉴 '내 표시'와 같은 값).
actual: 숫자 칸(span[data-nb=mk.CONS])이 처음 그릴 때 0이면 아예 만들어지지 않아서, 다른 화면으로 옮겨 메뉴를 다시 그리기 전까지 숫자가 없다. 이미 있던 숫자도 같은 창에서는 60초 타이머나 다른 창 storage 이벤트로만 바뀐다.
evidence: work/_tmp/ux4h_subject_2/p12.py: ann.CONS 0→1이 된 뒤 3초가 지나도 badge None. navSubj의 `${n!==''?`<span class="r" data-nb="mk.${S}">`:''}` · navBadges 호출처는 setInterval(60000)·storage·달력뿐.
cause: navSubj()(4347행)가 값이 빈 문서 줄에는 data-nb span을 만들지 않는다. Kit 저장 뒤 navBadges()를 부르지 않는다.
fix: _marks 줄은 값이 없어도 빈 span[data-nb]를 항상 두고, Kit이 저장·되돌리기·지우기를 할 때 navBadges()를 디바운스해서 부른다.
verify:
I reproduced both parts at 1280 and 1180 widths with playwright, using work/_tmp/ux4h_subject_2/p12.py and work/_tmp/ux4c_2_18/r.py.

Part 1, the count never appears: on #/CONS/WHT/learn with no marks, I highlighted a line. ann.CONS went from 0 to 1, but the subject menu element #nav [data-nb^="mk."] was still missing 3 seconds later. The same happened on OMS1/DD1 (oms 0 to 1, still no badge). The '1' only showed up after navigating back to CONS, which redraws the menu.

Part 2, the count goes stale: I reloaded with badge '1' already shown and highlighted a second line. ann.CONS became 2, but the badge still read '1' 2 seconds later.

The code matches both causes:
- navSubj in docs/index.html, line 4352, only creates the span[data-nb="mk.S"] when _marks is non-empty (`V['mk.'+S]||''`, a 0 count becomes '').
- navBadges is only called from the 60-second interval, the storage event from other windows, and calendar or exam-date changes. Saving in Kit does not call it.

No console errors. This is only a count display that is missing or late; the saved data is fine, so severity stays low. The proposed fix fits: always keep an empty data-nb span on the _marks row, and call navBadges with a debounce after Kit saves, undoes or clears.

title: 정리표 탭에서 과목 메뉴 카드 목차가 스크롤을 따라가지 않음(누른 카드만 표시)
screen: 강의 > 정리표 탭 + 과목 메뉴 카드 목차 (820 서랍, 1180·1280에서 M으로 메뉴를 연 경우)
repro: 1) 아이패드 세로에서 #/CONS/WHT/sum을 열고 중간까지 스크롤함. 2) 서랍을 열어 카드 목차를 봄.
expected: 학습 탭처럼 지금 보는 카드(행) 줄이 목차에서 표시된다(navToc도 sum 탭을 표시 대상으로 둠).
actual: 스크롤 후에는 .scard2.on이 없고, 목차를 눌러 이동했을 때만 그 줄이 표시된다.
evidence: work/_tmp/ux4h_subject_2/p4.py(pv): sum_mid y 3241 on None → sum_toc6 on '6'.
cause: learnSpy()(2782행)는 #lmini가 있는 학습 탭에서만 관찰자를 건다. navToc()(4345행)은 CUR.t==='sum'이어도 LCUR로 on을 표시하지만, sum에서는 LCUR를 goRow로만 바꾼다.
fix: 정리표 행(카드 j)에도 IntersectionObserver를 걸어 setLCur(j)를 부른다. 아니면 sum 탭에서는 목차 강조를 쓰지 않는다.
verify: I reproduced this at 820 (drawer) and 1280 (menu opened with M) using work/_tmp/ux4c_2_19/r.py. On #/CONS/WHT/sum I scrolled to 30% and 60% of the page. The visible row moved to m-WHT-5 / m-WHT-12 at 820 and m-WHT-2 / m-WHT-10 at 1280, but #nav .scard2.on stayed empty. Opening the drawer or pressing M did not highlight anything either. For comparison, the learn tab at mid-scroll does highlight a card (on=9 at 820, on=8 at 1280). The problem is actually slightly worse than the report says: after tapping TOC card 3 at 820 (it jumps to y=1411), I scrolled to 80%, where m-WHT-16 was visible, and reopened the drawer. Card 3 was still marked .on, so the highlight is stale, not just missing. The cause matches the code: learnSpy() (docs/index.html:2782) returns early when #lmini is absent, which it is on the sum tab. navToc (4345) treats sum as a tab that can be highlighted, but in sum the highlight is only set by clicking a TOC card. Nothing is lost and navigation still works; the only effect is a missing or misleading position marker in the card TOC, so severity is low.

title: 아이패드 세로 과목 홈 '강의 바로가기' 칩 하나만 말줄임으로 잘림
screen: 과목 홈(임플란트) .ljump — 820x1180
repro: 아이패드 세로에서 #/IMPL/_home을 열고 공부 순서 아래 '강의 바로가기' 칩 줄을 봄.
expected: 칩 줄이 여러 줄로 감기므로 강의 이름이 모두 보인다.
actual: 'Osseointegration·bone physiolo…'만 말줄임으로 잘린다. 나머지 칩은 전체가 보인다.
evidence: work/_tmp/ux4h_subject_2/p5.py pvIMPL tr: ['SPAN|Osseointegration·bone physiology|ellipsis'] · 스크린샷 work/_tmp/ux4h_subject_2/pv_impl_home.png
cause: .chip.ljc span에 max-width와 text-overflow:ellipsis가 걸려 있다(CSS 375·1500행 부근).
fix: #stage .ljump .ljc span의 max-width를 풀거나(칩 줄은 이미 wrap) 칩 max-width를 100%로 둔다.
verify:
I reproduced this with playwright at 820x1180 on #/IMPL/_home (script: /Users/jumisong/JBL/work/_tmp/ux4c_2_20/r.py). The page has 7 .ljump .ljc chips. Only 'Osseointegration·bone physiology' is cut off: its span's scrollWidth is larger than its clientWidth, it has text-overflow:ellipsis, and the chip is 188px wide. The other 6 chips show their full names.

Three other cases do not show it, which is consistent with the report saying only one chip is cut:
- IMPL at 1180x820: no chip cut.
- CONS at 820: no chip cut.
- OMS1 at 820: no chip cut.

The cause matches the report. docs/index.html line 375 sets `.chip.ljc{...max-width:15em}` and `.chip.ljc span{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}`. The line-1500 `#stage .ljump .ljc` override does not lift the max-width. The chip row already wraps, so this cap only serves to cut the name off.

Severity is low: it is cosmetic, the full name is still in the title tooltip, and clicking the chip still works.

title: 복습 보기(R)에서 Esc를 누르면 가려 둔 빨간 글씨가 전부 드러나고 '가리기 보기를 껐어요' 알림이 뜸(복습은 켜진 채)
screen: 강의 학습 탭 · ⚡ 복습 보기(R / [보기 ▾] 복습) · 세 뷰포트
repro: #/CONS/WHT/learn → R(복습 보기) → 팝업이 없는 상태에서 Esc 한 번(예: 팝업을 닫으려다 한 번 더 누름)
expected: 복습 보기의 빨간 글씨 가림은 그대로 두거나, Esc가 복습 보기 자체를 끔. 사용자가 켠 적 없는 '가리기 보기' 알림은 뜨지 않음
actual: QZ.on이 false가 되어 가린 빨간 글씨 206개가 한꺼번에 드러남. 알림은 '가리기 보기를 껐어요', [보기] 버튼은 계속 '복습'. RVQZ는 true로 남음
evidence: work/_tmp/ux4h_learn_2/p6.py 출력: R {qz:true,sc:'all',qzk:261,redvis:0,lmv:'복습'} → R_esc {qz:false,qzk:0,rev:true,lmv:'복습',toast:'가리기 보기를 껐어요',redvis:206}
cause: tools/cons/shell.html 3453 escStep의 `if(QZ.on){quizOff();toast('가리기 보기를 껐어요')}`가 복습 보기가 내부에서 켠 가리기(RVQZ, reviewSet 3982)를 구분하지 않음
fix: escStep에서 `if(QZ.on&&!RVQZ)`로 바꾸기(또는 RVQZ면 reviewSet(false)로 복습 보기 자체를 끄고 '복습 보기를 껐어요' 알림). Esc 순서 회귀 테스트에 R→Esc 추가
verify: Reproduced at 1280x900 and 820x1180 on #/CONS/WHT/learn using a real R keypress followed by Escape (script: work/_tmp/ux4c_2_21/r.py). After R: qz=true, 261 red words hidden (qzk=261), 0 visible, review=true, view button reads '복습'. After Esc: qz=false, qzk=0, 206 red words visible at once, review class still on, button still '복습', and the toast says '가리기 보기를 껐어요'. The user never turned 가리기 on. Cause confirmed in the built docs/index.html (same source as tools/cons/shell.html). escStep (line 3453) runs `if(QZ.on){quizOff();toast('가리기 보기를 껐어요');return;}` without checking RVQZ, the flag reviewSet (lines 3979-3983) sets when review mode turns 가리기 on internally. After this Esc, RVQZ stays true while QZ.on is false. The suggested fix is correct: skip this step when RVQZ is set, or have Esc call reviewSet(false) and show '복습 보기를 껐어요' instead. Severity is medium: no data is lost, but it undoes the recall hiding the user relied on, the alert names a mode they never turned on, and the review state is left inconsistent.

title: 가리기(Q·이 카드)를 켠 채 R을 누르면 복습 보기의 빨간 글씨 가림이 그 카드에만 걸림(나머지 빨간 글씨는 다 보임)
screen: 강의 학습 탭 · [보기 ▾] 가리기 → 복습
repro: #/CONS/WHT/learn → 카드 3으로 이동 → Q(가리기, 기본 범위 '이 카드') → R(복습)
expected: 복습 보기는 도움말대로 모든 카드의 빨간 글씨를 가림(범위 '강의 전체')
actual: 가려진 것은 카드 3의 13개뿐이고 복습 화면의 빨간 글씨 196개가 그대로 보임. R을 끄면 다시 '가리기'
evidence: p6.py 출력: Q_R {qz:true,sc:'card',qzk:13,rev:true,redvis:196}. 비교: 가리기 없이 R만 켜면 {sc:'all',qzk:261,redvis:0}
cause: shell.html 3982 reviewSet `if(on&&!QZ.on){QZ.scope='all'...RVQZ=true}` — 가리기가 이미 켜져 있으면 범위를 그대로 둠
fix: 복습을 켤 때 지금 QZ 상태(scope·card·on)를 저장해 두고 scope='all'로 바꿔 적용, 끌 때 저장한 상태로 되돌리기(RVQZ 대신 RVPREV={on,scope,cardAid})
verify: Reproduced on the built site (docs/index.html#/CONS/WHT/learn, 1280 wide, playwright; script at /Users/jumisong/JBL/work/_tmp/ux4c_2_22/v.py). Steps: go to card 3, press Q, then R. Result: QZ is on with scope 'card', only 18 red words are covered (all in card 3), review is on, and 194 red words in the review view are still visible. Pressing R again turns review off but the card-3 cover stays on and the button reads '가리기', so the earlier state survives as the report says. For comparison, pressing R alone covers the whole lecture (scope 'all', 261 covered, 0 visible) and pressing R again clears everything. The cause is confirmed in tools/cons/shell.html line 3982: `if(on&&!QZ.on){QZ.scope='all';...RVQZ=true;}` never changes the scope when the cover is already on. The help text for 복습 says red words are hidden ('빨간 글씨 가림'), so this breaks what the help promises: in medium review mode most key words show. Related case found in the same run: pressing R and then Q turns the cover off while review stays on, leaving 206 red words visible. That one is arguably a deliberate user toggle. When fixing, decide whether Q during review should switch the cover off or only change its scope. The suggested fix (save {on,scope,cardAid} when review turns on, force scope 'all', restore the saved state when it turns off) fits this code.

title: 도구 막대를 숨긴 상태(T·✕)에서 H·B를 누르면 막대는 숨은 채 형광펜·빈칸 모드만 켜짐(아무 표시 없음)
screen: 강의 학습 탭 · 도구 막대 숨김(kit-off) · 세 뷰포트(아이패드 하드웨어 키보드 포함)
repro: #/CONS/WHT/learn → T(도구 막대 숨김) → H(또는 B) → 본문 글자를 탭하거나 드래그
expected: H·B를 누르면 도구 막대가 다시 나타나고 모드가 켜짐(또는 켜지지 않고 'T로 도구 막대를 먼저 보이세요' 알림). 막대 없이 켜진 모드는 없어야 함
actual: body.kit-off인 채로 mode-h·mode-b가 켜지고 [✎ 도구]는 꺼진 모양 그대로. 켜짐 안내도 없어서 탭하거나 드래그하면 모르는 사이에 칠해짐. 이미 보고된 '숨기면 모드가 남음'과는 다른 경로(숨긴 뒤 키로 켜기)
evidence: p11.py 출력: T {kitoff:true,mode:''} → T_H {kitoff:true,mode:'h',kitt:['✎ 도구:false:false'],toast:''} → T_B {kitoff:true,mode:'b'}
cause: shell.html 3379 H/B 처리 → Kit.setMode(3049 Kit 안의 setMode)가 body.kit-off를 보지 않음. kitSet(4583)은 숨길 때만 Kit.off()를 부름
fix: 키 처리(3379)에서 H·B·Shift+H·Shift+B는 kit-off면 kitSet(true)를 먼저 부른 뒤 setMode 하기(또는 setMode 안에서 mode가 켜질 때 kit-off면 kitSet(true)). 펜슬로 바로 칠하기(PEN)도 kit-off면 쓸지 정하기
verify: I reproduced this at all three viewports (820x1180, 1180x820, 1280x800) using docs/index.html#/CONS/WHT/learn. The script is work/_tmp/ux4c_2_23/v.py. The steps were: press T, then H, then H again and B. After T the page has body.kit-off and #kit is display:none. After H, mode-h turns on and after B, mode-b turns on, but the toolbar stays hidden (kit-off stays set, #kit is display:none) and the [✎ 도구] button still shows as off. So a highlight or blank mode is live with no visible sign on screen. I did not test the actual tap or drag that would mark text; that part is inferred from the mode classes. Cause, confirmed in the built docs/index.html: the key handler at line 3389 (`if(K==='h')…Kit.setMode('h')`, and `K==='b'||K==='a'` → `Kit.setMode('b')`) calls Kit.setMode (line 3168), which never checks kit-off. kitSet (line 4583) only calls Kit.off() when hiding the toolbar. The A key (an alias for B) goes the same way. Line 3026 (#okh/#okb buttons on the JB screen, which also call Kit.setMode) is probably another path with the same problem. Suggested fix: in setMode, when a mode is turning on (mode would become non-null) and body has kit-off, call kitSet(true) first. That covers the keys, the A alias and okh/okb in one place. Shift+H and Shift+B only cycle colors, so they can be left alone or also bring the toolbar back. The fix belongs in the source tools/cons/shell.html.

title: 메모 창(Shift+M·메모 버튼)에서 Esc를 눌러도 창이 닫히지 않고, 커서가 메모에 남아 다음 단축키가 메모에 입력됨
screen: 강의 학습 탭 · 도구 막대 메모(#memo) · 세 뷰포트(하드웨어 키보드)
repro: #/CONS/WHT/learn → Shift+M(메모가 열리고 textarea에 포커스) → 몇 글자 입력 → Esc → H·J 누르기
expected: Esc = 메모 저장 후 닫기(또는 적어도 blur해서 단축키로 돌아가기). 도움말의 'Esc 한 단계씩(팝업 닫기)'과 같게
actual: Esc 뒤에도 activeElement가 memota이고 #memo.on 그대로. 'hbv test'처럼 이어 누른 단축키가 메모 글자로 저장됨(새로고침 뒤 LS memo.CONS.WHT='hbv test'). 메모를 닫는 방법은 [닫기] 버튼뿐
evidence: p7.py 출력(세 뷰포트 같음): memo_typed {v:'hbv test',mode:''} · memo_esc {ae:'memota',memo:['memota:hbv test']} · memo_reload ['jblhub.v1.memo.CONS.WHT="hbv test"']
cause: shell.html 3371 전역 keydown이 isTextField면 바로 return하고, 메모 textarea(3344~3348)에는 keydown 처리가 없음. escStep(3452)의 팝업 목록에도 '#memo.on'이 없어 포커스를 옮긴 뒤 Esc를 눌러도 안 닫힘
fix: $('#memota')에 keydown Esc → e.preventDefault(); saveMemo(); textarea.blur(); #memo 닫기를 추가하고, escStep 팝업 목록에 '#memo.on'을 넣기(gsearch Esc 처리 3539와 같은 방식)
verify: Reproduced at 1180x820 with a fresh playwright profile (script: work/_tmp/ux4c_2_24/memo_esc.py). Steps: #/CONS/WHT/learn, then Shift+M. The memo opens with focus on memota. I typed 'ab' and pressed Esc: focus stayed on memota and #memo.on stayed set. Typing 'hj' after that went into the memo ('abhj'), and after a reload LS jblhub.v1.memo.CONS.WHT='abhj'. Second condition: I blurred the textarea first and then pressed Esc. The memo still stayed open (on=True), because escStep's pops selector (docs/index.html 3452) has no '#memo.on'. Cause confirmed in code: the global keydown (3371) returns early when isTextField(target) is true, and #memota (3344-3348) has no keydown handler of its own. So Esc inside the memo does nothing, and the only way to close it is the [닫기] button or the memo toggle. The fix proposed in the report is sound: add an Esc handler on #memota that saves, blurs and closes the memo, and add '#memo.on' to escStep. Severity is medium, not high: nothing is lost, but shortcuts typed after Esc silently end up in the saved memo text. I removed the test memo key afterwards.

title: 정리표·비교표 탭에서 Q(가리기)가 안 됨: 첫 Q는 학습 탭에서 켠 보이지 않는 가리기를 끄기만 하고, 두 번째 Q는 '가릴 빨간 핵심어가 없어요'
screen: 강의 정리표 탭(#/CONS/WHT/sum) · Q 키 · Esc
repro: #/CONS/WHT/learn → Q(가리기 켬) → 2(정리표) → Q → Q → Esc
expected: 정리표에서 Q = 이 화면의 빨간 핵심어 가리기(도움말의 'Q 가리기'). 다른 탭에서 켠 가리기가 여기서 보이지 않는 상태로 남지 않음
actual: 정리표로 오면 QZ.on=true인데 가려진 칸은 0개. 첫 Q는 아무 변화 없이 그 상태를 끄기만 함. 두 번째 Q는 '이 카드에는 가릴 빨간 핵심어가 없어요 — ⚡에서 범위를 넓혀 보세요'(정리표에는 카드가 없음). 학습 탭에서 켠 채 정리표에서 Esc를 누르면 '가리기 보기를 껐어요'
evidence: p6.py 출력: sum {qz:true,sc:'card',qzk:0} → sum_Q1 {qz:false, 새 알림 없음} → sum_Q2 {qz:false,toast:'이 카드에는 가릴 빨간 핵심어가 없어요…'}. p5.py Q_tab2 {h:'#/CONS/WHT/sum',qz:true,qzk:0}
cause: shell.html 2748 mount가 같은 강의 안에서는 QZ.on을 유지하고, QZ.card=findAid(학습 카드 aid)가 정리표에서는 null. quizOn(3430)의 기본 범위 'card'가 curCard()를 쓰는데, 정리표에는 .tc·.qc·.pc가 없어 null

cause: tools/cons/shell.html 4169행(ux4 B28): msum 카드형에서 `e.clientY-r.top < 40 && e.clientX-r.left < 200`이면 칸 이름을 누른 것으로 봄. 칸 이름(td::before)은 인라인이라 실제 높이가 한 줄(약 20px)이고 폭도 칸 이름 글자 폭뿐.

What I did: opened #/CONS/WHT/sum and tapped the 🔑 cell of the second row card 4px from the left and 24px from the top. That point is in the 2-4px gap between the column name line (::before, inline, y 5..21) and the second text line (y 26..42). The column hid and the toast said "‘🔑 요지·핵심’ 열을 가렸어요". covcells went 0 to 19, so every row's 🔑 cell was hidden.

Tapping directly on the text (for example 150,30 or 60,36) does not hide the column. Those taps land on DIV.mg, and the check in shell.html (~4169) only fires when `lc===t`, meaning the td itself is the target. So only the blank spots between and around the text trigger it.

How big the problem area is (r2.py, sampled with elementFromPoint in the 200x40 zone):
- 🔑 column: roughly 660 to 1300 of 1950 sample points below the column name line hit the td itself, so they all trigger the hide.
- det and mem columns: roughly 1200 of 1800 such points.
- ex and mem cards (column name on its own line, content starts at 24px): only about 70 such points.
- topic column: about 50 such points.

So in cards where the column name sits on the same line as the text (key, det), a tap that falls in the space between lines near the top hides the whole column. The 40px/200px zone is much larger than the column name's actual height (one line, about 17px) and width (about 108px).

Making ::before display:block, or limiting the check to the column name's first-line height and text width, would fix it.

cause: 실행 취소 목록은 sessionStorage 'undo.<S>'에 저장됨(stackSave·stackLoad, index.html 3156–3157행). studyReplace(3795–3798행)는 localStorage만 바꾸고 location.reload()를 하므로 새로고침 뒤 stackLoad가 옛 목록을 그대로 불러옴. 목록의 각 항목 e.p[aid]는 복원 전 기준의 블록 전체 목록이라 swap()이 블록을 통째로 덮어씀. 합치기(mergeData) 경로도 목록을 비우지 않음.
fix: studyReplace가 reload하기 전(과 파일 합치기 뒤)에 sessionStorage의 NS+'undo.*' 키를 모두 지운다. 더 안전하게는 stackSave에 annAt.<S>를 함께 저장하고, stackLoad에서 LS annAt.<S>가 다르면(다른 창·복원으로 바뀜) 목록을 버린다.
verify:
Reproduced at 1180x820 (touch) with work/_tmp/ux4c_2_53/r1.py, a copy of the reported t3.py; output is in r1.out. Steps: highlight 'Adequate' on #t-WHT-3, take an auto-backup, highlight 'Non-vital', restore that backup through the #rpop snapshot button, accept the confirm, reload.

What happened:
- Before the restore, the marks were ['Adequate','Non-vital'] and the ↶ counter showed 2.
- After the restore, the marks were ['Adequate'] but ↶ still showed 2.
- The first ↶ changed nothing on screen, yet the toast said '↶ 되돌림: 형광펜 1개'.
- The second ↶ removed all marks, including the restored 'Adequate'. That is the same toast again, for a different change.
- No page errors.

Cause, confirmed in the code (docs/index.html):
- The undo stack lives in sessionStorage 'undo.<S>' (stackSave and stackLoad, lines 3156-3157).
- studyReplace (line 3798) changes only localStorage, sets SS rstDone, then calls location.reload(). The rstDone handler (line 3813) only shows a toast.
- The file-merge path (line 3810) also reloads without clearing the stack.
- After the reload, load() calls stackLoad(), which brings the old stack back. Its entries replace whole blocks with the pre-restore contents.

I tested only the snapshot restore at 1180 and did not run the other viewports. The replace-with-file and merge paths go through the same code, so the same behavior is expected there.

The user can win the marks back with ↷ in the same session. Even so, after a restore ↶ silently wipes restored marks and the toast is misleading, so I rate it high.

Fix: clear the sessionStorage keys NS+'undo.*' before the reload in studyReplace and in fileRestore (merge), or reset the stack when rstDone or mergeRes is found on load.

title: 빈칸 모드에서 형광펜 단어를 누르면 빈칸이 생기지 않고 형광펜이 지워짐 · 형광펜 모드에서 빈칸을 누르면 저장해 둔 빈칸이 지워짐
screen: 강의 학습·정리표 도구 막대 형광펜/빈칸 모드 (손가락 톡·마우스 클릭, 세 뷰포트)
repro: 1) #/CONS/WHT/learn에서 H를 켜고 'Adequate'를 눌러 형광펜 2) B(빈칸)를 켜고 같은 'Adequate'를 손가락으로 톡 3) 다른 단어를 빈칸으로 만든 뒤 H를 켜고 그 빈칸을 톡
expected: 빈칸 모드에서 누르면 그 단어가 빈칸이 되어야 함(형광펜으로 표시한 핵심어를 빈칸으로 바꾸는 흔한 흐름). 형광펜 모드에서 빈칸을 누르면 형광펜이 더해지거나, 적어도 빈칸이 조용히 지워지면 안 됨.
actual: 2)에서 형광펜만 지워지고 빈칸은 생기지 않음(h 1→0, b 0). 3)에서 빈칸이 지워짐(b 1→0). 두 경우 모두 무엇이 지워졌는지 알림이 없음.
evidence: work/_tmp/ux4h_touchdata_2/t12.py 출력: h ['Adequate',{h:1,b:0}] → b_tap_on_h ['Adequate',{h:0,b:0}, 알림 ''] · h_tap_on_b ['Extensively',{h:0,b:0}, 알림 '']
cause: Kit tapAt()(index.html 3176–3180행 부근)은 누른 곳에 [data-rk]가 있으면 종류를 따지지 않고 push('…지우기 1개')를 한 뒤 unwrap함. 같은 색 형광펜(recol)이나 빈칸 색(brecol)일 때만 다르게 처리하고, 지금 모드(t)와 표시 종류(h/b)가 다른 경우는 따로 처리하지 않음.
fix: tapAt에서 rk의 data-rk가 t와 다르면 그 묶음을 지우지 말고 종류를 바꾼다(push('형광펜→빈칸')으로 같은 범위를 wrap(B,a,b,t,…)로 다시 칠하거나, 빈칸 모드에서는 형광펜 위에 빈칸을 겹침). 지우는 경우에는 undoToast로 '빈칸 1개 지움 ↶'를 보여 준다.
verify:
I reproduced this with both touch and mouse (work/_tmp/ux4c_2_54/t12.py for touch, t12m.py for mouse, 1180x820, #/CONS/WHT/learn, card #t-WHT-3).

1. Highlight 'Adequate': h=1, b=0.
2. Switch to blank mode (B) and tap the same word: result is h=0, b=0. The highlight is removed and no blank is created.
3. Blank 'Extensively', switch to highlight mode (H) and tap it: result is h=0, b=0. The saved blank is removed.

The toast text was '' in every case, so nothing tells the user a mark was removed.

The cause is in docs/index.html, tapAt at line 3178. Tapping any [data-rk] element runs push('...지우기 1개') and then unwraps it. It only special-cases same-kind marks of a different colour (recol / brecol) and never compares the current mode t with the mark's kind (data-rk).

Because of push(), undo should still bring the mark back, so no data is permanently lost. That is why I rate it medium and not high. It still breaks the common flow of turning a highlighted keyword into a blank, and marks are removed without any notice.

title: 메모를 쓰고 0.3초 안에 새로고침·뒤로 가기(스와이프)·탭 이동을 하면 마지막에 쓴 글이 사라짐
screen: 강의 메모(Shift+M·도구 막대 메모) — 맥 ⌘R, 아이패드 뒤로 스와이프, 앱 전환
repro: 1) #/CONS/WHT/learn에서 메모를 열고 '첫 줄 abc'를 입력한 뒤 1초 기다리기 2) ' 마지막'을 입력하고 바로 새로고침 → 3) 정리표 → 학습으로 이동한 뒤 메모에 ' XYZ'를 입력하고 바로 history.back()
expected: 입력칸에 보이던 글은 새로고침하거나 화면을 옮겨도 모두 저장되어 있어야 함.
actual: 새로고침 뒤 저장된 값은 '첫 줄 abc'로, ' 마지막'이 사라짐. 뒤로 간 뒤에도 '첫 줄 abc' 그대로이고 ' XYZ'는 어디에도 저장되지 않음.
evidence: work/_tmp/ux4h_touchdata_2/t11.py 출력: reload '"첫 줄 abc"' · after_back ['#/CONS/WHT/sum','"첫 줄 abc"']
cause: 메모는 oninput 300ms 디바운스와 onblur로만 저장됨(index.html 3346–3348행). pagehide나 visibilitychange(hidden)일 때 saveMemo를 부르지 않음. openDoc(2680행)은 저장 대기 중인 글을 먼저 저장하지 않은 채 #memota.value를 새 문서 메모로 덮어씀. 스와이프나 history.back은 blur를 일으키지 않아 이 경우에 해당함.
fix: openDoc에서 memota.value를 바꾸기 전에 clearTimeout(mt)를 하고, ta.value!==memoBase.v이면 이전 CUR 키로 saveMemo()를 부른다. pagehide와 visibilitychange(hidden)에도 대기 중인 메모를 바로 저장한다(posNow 옆에 추가).
verify: Reproduced with work/_tmp/ux4c_2_55/t11.py (a copy of the reporter's script) against docs/index.html at 820x1180 with touch. Output: reload saved '"첫 줄 abc"', so ' 마지막' was lost. after_back was ['#/CONS/WHT/sum', '"첫 줄 abc"'], so ' XYZ' was not saved under any memo key. The code agrees with the report. The memo saves only on the 300ms oninput debounce and on onblur (line 3348). Nothing saves the memo on pagehide or visibilitychange; the existing handlers at lines 3844 and 3870 call only lqWrite and posNow. openDoc (line 2680) sets #memota.value from localStorage without first flushing the pending debounce timer. The learn and sum tabs share the key memo.CONS.WHT, so when popstate runs openDoc for the same document, the unsaved text in the textarea is overwritten. Clicking a tab is less affected because the click blurs the textarea first and onblur saves. The loss happens only with reload, back swipe or history.back, and app switching, none of which blur the field. The loss is limited to the last 0.3s of typing, but it is silent user data loss, so medium fits. The proposed fix is correct: in openDoc, clearTimeout(mt) and save if the textarea differs from memoBase before overwriting, and flush on pagehide and on visibilitychange(hidden).

title: hover 스타일 89개가 (hover:hover)로 막혀 있지 않아, 아이패드에서 누른 뒤 버튼이 눌린 것처럼 색이 남음
screen: 도구 막대(#kit)·미니바·JB 필터·알약 등 — 아이패드 820·1180
repro: 아이패드에서 도구 막대 [형광펜]을 톡 눌러 켰다가 다시 톡 눌러 끄기
expected: 끈 버튼은 바탕색 없이 원래 모양으로 돌아와야 함
actual: iOS는 마지막으로 누른 요소에 :hover를 계속 적용함. '#kit button:hover:not(:disabled){background:#F4F1EA}'가 남아 꺼진 버튼도 옅은 바탕으로 보여, 켜짐과 꺼짐을 헷갈리게 함(4차에서 켜짐을 '버튼 눌림 모양만'으로 표시하게 바꿔 더 헷갈림).
evidence: CSS 조사: :hover 규칙 89개 중 @media (hover:hover) 안에 있는 것 0개(t 스크립트 출력 'hover rules 89 in hover-media 0')
cause: hover 규칙을 전부 조건 없이 선언함
fix: 바탕색을 바꾸는 :hover 규칙을 @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){…} 안으로 옮긴다(최소한 #kit·#dtabs .lmini·.tg·.b3lk).
verify: I confirmed this from the built docs/index.html. I didn't reproduce it on an actual iPad, because Chromium touch emulation doesn't copy iOS's sticky-hover behavior. The file has 90 ':hover' occurrences. Only three @media rules check hover, and none of them contain a :hover rule. Two use (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) and only turn on .okeys and .jbkeys. One uses (hover:none) and only hides .fckeys. None of the rules the report names is wrapped. '#kit button:hover:not(:disabled){background:#F4F1EA}' applies everywhere. The same goes for '#dtabs .lmini button:hover,#dtabs .lmini2 button:hover,.dhk button:hover{background:var(--tint)!important}', '#stage #jbbar .tg:hover{background:var(--tint)}' and '#stage .pills .tg:hover{background:var(--tint)}'. '#stage .b3lk:hover' only adds an underline. So after a tap on iOS, where :hover sticks to the last element touched, a [형광펜] button that was just turned off keeps the pale beige #F4F1EA background. On desktop the off state has no background. An on button looks different: accent-color text, bold, an accent border and an accent-tinted background from '#kit button.on'. The two states can still be told apart, but an off button that stays shaded after a tap is confusing next to the "shown only as pressed" on style. That makes this a real but cosmetic, low-severity bug. Fix as proposed: move the :hover rules that change the background into @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine), at least #kit, #dtabs .lmini/.lmini2/.dhk, .tg and .b3lk. Nothing was written to work/_tmp/ux4c_2_59/ other than creating that folder.
